whyItMatters: An AWS access key ID in source means cloud credentials may live in version control. The ID alone cannot authenticate, but where the ID sits, the secret is often nearby.
actions: Check whether the matching secret key is also exposed; if so, revoke the key pair in IAM immediately.
Move credentials to environment variables or a secret manager loaded at runtime.
Audit what the key accessed during the exposure window.
verification: A fresh scan shows no DPK-SEC-001 finding and IAM lists the key as revoked or absent.
